name: Movchazne Vidlunnia
source:
Trapped in darkness, you meet a stranger who offers riddles. Solve them… and perhaps remember who you really are.

[From [url=https://seanlired.itch.io/silent-echo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
受困于黑暗之中的你，遇见了一名向你抛出谜题的陌生人。解开这些谜题吧……或许你就能重新记起自己真正的身份。

[摘自[url=https://seanlired.itch.io/silent-echo]itch.io[/url]]
